_provenance: Derived values of the task, shared by grader.py and the circuits under circuits/. L is the term count of the [2Fe-2S] (30e,20o) Jordan-Wigner table after truncation at |w| >= 1e-4 Ha. fcidump_sha256 pins the decompressed data/fcidump.xz, the FCIDUMP file of Li and Chan (2017) from github.com/zhendongli2008/Active-space-model-for-Iron-Sulfur-Clusters. data_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the 41,052 alias words of data/table.json.xz as little-endian u64. The row order places rows in frame blocks over the seven commuting frames {F, C, D, D2, s_thio, s_d45, x_muS}; regions lists the 14 maximal runs of blocks with the same frame set. The alias words come from the credit-aligned melt schedule of reference.py and alias_sched.py. masks_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the Pauli masks (flip | zy<<40 | ny2<<80) as 16-byte little-endian blocks. The grader keeps its own derivation and asserts that this file matches it.
